mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionMatrix removes all (Relationship × OperationKind) constraints from PermMatrix.allowed. Combined with F_OutcomeDeterminedByMatrix also cleared (or left consistent with injected violation), Alloy can freely assign any outcome to any access. The injection forces a compliance officer to have a Permitted GetRecord access, directly violating LeastPrivilege, FR_007 and FR_019.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ComplianceReadsClinicalContent { some a: Access | a.accUser.userRole = RoleComplianceOfficer and a.accOpKind = GetRecord and a.accOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CareTeamRelationshipCorrectness severs the link between CareTeamClinician relationship and actual CareTeamMembership rows. The injection forces a clinician to be classified as CareTeamClinician (and therefore Permitted) on a record for which no membership exists, exactly the care-team gating bypass FR-004 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamBypass { some a: Access, u: User, r: Record | a.accUser = u and a.accRecord = r and u.userRole = RoleClinician and a.accRel = CareTeamClinician and a.accOutcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctClinician = u and m.ctRecord = r) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_NoteAuthorIsClinician removes the structural constraint that only clinicians can author notes. The injection places a patient as a note author, which is exactly the write-privilege escalation FR-012 and data-model.md's author_role CHECK prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientAuthorsNote { some n: ClinicalNote, u: User | n.noteAuthor = u and u.userRole = RolePatient }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditCompleteness removes the bijection between Access atoms and AuditEntry atoms. The injection forces an Access with no linked audit entry, which is the exact SC-001/SC-002 violation (a record access with no matching audit entry).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AccessWithoutAudit { some a: Access | no a.accAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AttributionCorrectness allows audit entries to record a different role or accessor than the actual caller. The injection forces an audit entry whose recorded accessor role differs from the user's actual role, violating FR-014's requirement that accessor_role be snapshotted accurately from the authenticated identity context.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAuditEntry { some a: Access | a.accAudit.aeAccessorRole != a.accUser.userRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PatientOwnRecordCorrectness severs the link between PatientOwnRecord relationship and the patient's assigned_record_id. The injection forces a patient to receive Permitted access on a record that is not their assigned record, which is the cross-patient information disclosure FR-006 and SC-010 explicitly prohibit.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientAccessesOtherRecord { some a: Access, u: User, r: Record | a.accUser = u and a.accRecord = r and u.userRole = RolePatient and u.assignedRecord != r and a.accOutcome = Permitted and a.accOpKind = GetRecord }
